Garden consultation

A useful second pair of eyes.

For a specific problem, a smaller garden or a first step before committing to a full design. We help you decide what to keep, what to change and where to begin.

What’s included

A clear scope.
No guesswork.

  • A focused visit to your garden
  • Advice on layout, planting and priorities
  • A written summary of recommendations
  • Suggested next steps for your budget

90-minute visit · £195

Typical timing: Notes within 5 working days

Ask about this service

How it works

Before the visit, send a few photographs and the questions you would most like answered. We walk around the garden together and discuss practical options. You receive a short written summary, so the useful ideas do not get lost.

Before you book

Includes travel within 20 miles of Bath. Consultations do not include scaled drawings. Additional travel is agreed before booking.
